description: config.v2 §2.2, §3: a contract's `config.groups` and the types it names -> the declared groups and the derived types, or the reasons the declaration is invalid; and a contract's resources -> the lint's findings. Written by an independent reading of the text (Python, standard library), checked, never blessed. `schema` is a packed document (core §7.6) whose types the cases' groups name, as `packed:<Name>` or `packed:schema#<Name>`, its stem being `schema`. A case gives `groups`, the annotation's value as TOML reads it into JSON -> `expect`: {declaration: "declared", groups, derived, layouts} or {declaration: "invalid", reasons}. `groups` lists each group as declared: name, class, its type's name, settable (hot or reach), and its parameters in its type's field order, each with name, kind (int or bool), minimum and maximum (null for a bool), width (core §7.6), unit (null where `units` gives none) and sensitive; a marker item `...` is kept where it stands. `derived` maps each derived type's name to its `fields` as `zk2 config derive` writes them, in derivation order: Record, Set<T> for each hot or reach group in the groups' order, T being its type's name, Control, Error. A field lists name, type and its type's members; `optional` appears only when true, and no field carries a description. `layouts` gives each derived type's tag, the sha256 of its layout form's JCS bytes (core §7.6), and min_bits and max_bits, the shortest and the longest record before the pad. `reasons` are {entry, reason}: entry null for the annotation whole, `groups_value` (not an array, no group, more than 16 groups, or a marker first, last or after a marker; nothing else is then checked); else each item by its index in the array, markers counted, its reasons in this order, each check made alone and one that needs a wrong value skipped: group_value (the item is neither a table nor the string `...`, which skips the rest, or a table holding a member other than name, class, type, units and sensitive), group_name (missing, not a string, not [a-z][a-z0-9]*(_[a-z0-9]+)*, or an earlier group's), group_class (not hot, reach or contract), group_type (missing; not a packed reference that names one listed type; a type with a marker, an optional field, a field that is not int or bool, a `reserved` member, more than 16 fields, a field name not of the group name's form, or one of confirm_s, token, expected_revision, idempotency_key, dry_run, writable, pending, last; or an earlier group's type), group_units (not a table; or, with a valid type, a key naming no int field of it, or a value that is not a non-empty string), group_sensitive (not an array; or, with a valid type, an item that is not a field's name, or a name twice). `contracts` gives a contract's resources resolved (core §9.3: kind, optional, params the template's parameters, annotations merged; a state's or an event's type, an operation's request, response and error, fanout, idempotent, serving and replies; an event's rate and retention), its `uses` and the packed document they name. Each case is `contracts_base`, the test contract resolved, with the case's `uses` in place of its own where given, each of the case's `resources` replacing the resource of its template or, null, removing it, and `contracts_packed`, the test contract's rfcfg.json, with the case's `types` replacing or adding the types they name; or a case gives `contract`, a path under `conformance/` read whole -> `expect.findings`, [{at, reason}] in this order: groups_missing (no resource `config` with `config.groups`; nothing else is checked), groups_invalid (the declaration is invalid; nothing else is checked), then for config, set/<g> for each hot or reach group in order, confirm, cancel, extend, persist and change: resource_missing; else resource_shape (a template parameter; config not a non-optional state of a packed type; an operation not of kind operation, optional other than persist's true, fanout not forbidden, idempotent not false, serving not exclusive, replies not one, or a request, response or error that is not one packed type; change not a non-optional event of the standard schema's ConfigChangeEvent, `standard_schema` below, with rate burst(600/h) and retention 7d); else config_derivation (a type whose fields are not its derivation's: the same items in the same order, a marker for a marker, each field with the same name, type, width, optional and type members, descriptions and the types' own names aside); for config alone, then freshness (no freshness.ttl_s above 0 on it, or uses lacking freshness.v2); then each other resource whose template is `set` or begins `set/`, in byte order: set_not_settable; then each resource other than config holding `config.groups`, in byte order: groups_place. `standard_schema` names config.v2.json and its artifact id (the sha256 of its JCS bytes), and `contract_groups` the declared groups of the test contract.
